name: Geert Wilders
role: Dutch member of parliament and founder of the Party for Freedom (PVV)
summary: Wilders advocates sharply restricting immigration and restricting Islamic institutions and practices in the Netherlands. He emphasizes Dutch sovereignty and cultural identity, and has called for directing public spending toward Dutch households and services.
